procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the seven pages are LANDSCAPE-GENUINE (raw ~2420x1877 renders read upright directly, no transpose -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/clarke/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (10/10).

Terry) and Place 2 (Amanda Trawick Rainey); Circuit Court 10-Circuit District 10 Place 1 (Charles W. Wright Jr.) and Place 2 (Robert T. 'Bo' Bailey) -- the same Circuit 10 roster Kemper prints, names identical. Printed totals: Colom 2414, Hyde-Smith 3135, Pinkins 130, Chiaradio 2310, Guest 3305, Klehle 52, Terry 4759, Rainey 4753, Wright 4802, Bailey 4761.
operator_rows_note: All 10 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; every row carries p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (eleven precinct cells) + the p4 Union cell + the p4 printed TOTAL. No X cells print in any in-scope row.
